verdict.rationale: Per-end-user credential isolation is a fair question for an MCP gateway and hosting platform, so the axis applies. The pack only says gateway calls are 'credential-managed' and offers per-tool enable/disable, plus OAuth 2.1 support in the browser inspector for testing. None of this shows separate connected accounts or scoped tokens per end user of a customer's product, so each user's agent acting only on that user's credentials is unevidenced.
